mutations.cell: native probe diagnostics preserve nested module records as one JSON line

why: The real CLI version child loads the native trace hook and core module. The report emits the same formatter used by failure-only captures. Its parsed output must retain the observed module digest. Original auth children and assertions remain uninstrumented, with their 120-second timeout unchanged. Only additional instrumented captures use a 10-second timeout and at most eight attempts per failed format.
